detailed_descriptions.en: The Trapped in Limbo DLC is included in the Atomic Pass. Requires the base game Atomic Heart to run. Continue the story by diving back into the mad world of Limbo! Get through a combat extravaganza and Limbo-flavored challenges to learn P-3’s fate. Experience the contrast of worlds with unconventional mechanics selected to blow you away. The Trapped in Limbo DLC features: • Continuation of the story in new sections of the twisted Limbo world, meticulously created by the brilliant mind of Artem Galeev, Art Director of the Mundfish studio. Help P-3 to break free and, this time, explore what happens after the different ending of the main campaign. • Insane gameplay with new rules packed into the Limbo-flavored favorite challenges. Run, jump, slide across platforms and fight bizarre enemies in a combat extravaganza. • Marvelously-looking weapons and skills to earn as you collect apples and coins, progressing through the depth of P-3’s mind. • Up to 7 unique weapon skins for P-3 to unlock, which you can equip in the Atomic Heart’s main campaign.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Trapped in Limbo DLC is included in the Atomic Pass. Requires the base game Atomic Heart to run.

Continue the story by diving back into the mad world of Limbo! Get through a combat extravaganza and Limbo-flavored challenges to learn P-3’s fate. Experience the contrast of worlds with unconventional mechanics selected to blow you away.

The Trapped in Limbo DLC features:

• Continuation of the story in new sections of the twisted Limbo world, meticulously created by the brilliant mind of Artem Galeev, Art Director of the Mundfish studio. Help P-3 to break free and, this time, explore what happens after the different ending of the main campaign.

• Insane gameplay with new rules packed into the Limbo-flavored favorite challenges. Run, jump, slide across platforms and fight bizarre enemies in a combat extravaganza.

• Marvelously-looking weapons and skills to earn as you collect apples and coins, progressing through the depth of P-3’s mind.

• Up to 7 unique weapon skins for P-3 to unlock, which you can equip in the Atomic Heart’s main campaign.
